nodes.description: HYPER-REPRESSION (South Bending): Mars is at maximum Southern latitude. Foundational collapse; the energy implodes. Hidden failure or rot at the root. Structural stress test leading to internal fracture.
HYPER-EXPOSURE (North Bending): Jupiter is at maximum Northern latitude. Structural instability due to overload. 'Icarus' effect—flying too high. Risk of public spectacle or burnout.

EXCRETION/DIMINUTION: The Saturn signal is drained by the Dragon's Tail. Material volume is reduced; spectrality, loss of form, and hypo-manifestation. The native is haunted by the absence or corruption of this energy.
INTAKE/AMPLIFICATION: The North_Node signal is magnified by the Dragon's Maw. Material volume increases; risk of gluttony, inflation, and hyper-manifestation. The native is insatiable in this domain.

EXCRETION/DIMINUTION: The South_Node signal is drained by the Dragon's Tail. Material volume is reduced; spectrality, loss of form, and hypo-manifestation. The native is haunted by the absence or corruption of this energy.
